subject: Restructure: consolidation of marketplace commits & 18mo private offer
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bighealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@bighealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal timing + consolidation question

Hi Sofia,

Hope you're well — our renewal window for the Redwood marketplace subscription is coming up in June. We currently have two adjacent private-offer commitments (one for compute-heavy inference and one for embeddings) that renew on different schedules. Procurement asked if we can consolidate them into a single 18-month private offer with a single PO to simplify vendor ops and get a better blended rate.

Two quick asks: can Redwood support an 18-month term (instead of 12) and combine our existing SKU commits under one private offer? If so, what's the earliest you can get updated paperwork and an AWS private-offer link?

Thanks — Elena

Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, BigHealth Inc.
elena.ruiz@bighealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: BigHealth_Renewal_Timeline.xlsx]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bighealth.com>
Cc: Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@bighealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + consolidation question

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and for flagging the goal (single PO + simpler ops). We can support an 18-month private offer and consolidate the two commits.

High-level plan:
- I’ll loop in finance/legal to prepare a consolidated private-offer PDF and AWS proposal link.
- Pricing: we can propose a blended rate based on the combined annualized commit; there’s a small additional discount for 18 months versus 12 months.
- Ops: to avoid downtime, we’ll set the start date to align with your June renewal and prorate the interim month(s).

Next steps on our side: Marissa will run the pricing workbook and Rafael will review the PO language. Can you confirm the exact subscription SKUs and current committed monthly units (compute and embeddings)? If you prefer, share your PO template and we’ll attach the signed PO to the private-offer flow.

I’ll target a first-draft private-offer and AWS link by EOD 4/20.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0146

---

> Hope you're well — our renewal window for the Redwood marketplace subscription is coming up in June...

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: BigHealth consolidation (18mo) — pricing & legal review

Team — forwarding a renewal ask from BigHealth (details above). Quick asks: 
- Marissa: can you run a blended pricing for an 18-month consolidated commit (compute + embeddings)? Use the worksheet attached and model a modest incremental discount for the longer term. Also include an ARR and monthly burn schedule for AWS billing.
- Rafael: legal check — we need to ensure the PO terms map cleanly into the private-offer template; flag any redlines that might block AWS onboarding.
- Soojin: if this is approved, can you provision the AWS private-offer link once legal signs off?

I’ve attached the customer timeline and our last price sheet. I’m aiming to have a formal private-offer draft for the customer by 4/20.

Thanks — Sofia

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: BigHealth consolidation (18mo) — pricing & legal review

Folks — attached is the pricing worksheet and the draft private-offer PDF (Redwood_Private_Offer_v1.pdf). Summary:
- Consolidated 18-month commit: $1,800,000 total commit (equates to $1.2M annualized) across compute + embeddings.
- Blended per-token/unit rate reduced by ~8% versus current combined spend.
- Proposed start date: 2027-06-01; pro-rated credit applied for the May portion to avoid double-billing.

Rafael — I left a few placeholder clauses in the PDF where legal needs to confirm the audit/data residency language.

Elena — attaching so you have the draft. If the customer is aligned, next step is: BigHealth returns a PO (we can accept the PO as a signed PDF). Once we have the signed PO we’ll request the AWS private-offer link and finish the onboarding.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Offer_v1.pdf, Commit_Consolidation_Worksheet.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bighealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@bighealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-21T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + consolidation question

Sofia — this looks good, thanks. Two items from procurement: 
1) Please update section 5 (audit and data residency) to reflect ISO 27001 + EU data handling carve-outs — I can send language.
2) We prefer a single PO referencing the consolidated private offer. I’ve attached BigHealth_PO_Template.pdf — please populate and return for signature.

We’ll aim to sign quickly if you can confirm the AWS private-offer flow and provide the final PDF.

Elena

[Attachment: BigHealth_PO_Template.pdf]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bighealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Sales <aws-marketplace-sales@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: consolidated 18mo private offer + populated PO

Elena / team — attaching the populated PO and updated private-offer PDF per your audit/residency notes. Rafael reviewed the redlines and approved the revised clause set.

What I’ve attached:
- Signed_PO_BigHealth_0423.pdf (populated using your template)
- Redwood_Private_Offer_v1.pdf (updated with ISO 27001 + EU carve-outs)
- Commit_Consolidation_Worksheet.xlsx (final pricing model)

Next operational steps (for transparency):
1) I’ll upload the signed PO to the AWS private-offer request and ping AWS Marketplace to generate the proposal link (aws will send to both Redwood and BigHealth).
2) Once the AWS link is live, BigHealth will accept the private offer in the console and the 18-month term will be recorded; billing will follow the consolidated commit schedule.
3) Post-acceptance: CS will schedule onboarding + KV cache migration planning to align traffic and avoid cold starts.

Marissa / Soojin: please open the private-offer request with AWS immediately upon upload. Rafael: retain the signed PO in legal archive and add to the contract binder.

Elena — thank you for the speedy turnaround. I’ll confirm the AWS link as soon as I have it (target: EOD 4/24).

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
